title: Armchair
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- floor shadow -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="88" rx="36" ry="5" fill="#1b2a4a"/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x="20" y="78" width="7" height="11" rx="2" fill="#8a5a2b"/>
  <rect x="73" y="78" width="7" height="11" rx="2" fill="#8a5a2b"/>
  <rect x="30" y="76" width="6" height="10" rx="2" fill="#b07a3f"/>
  <rect x="64" y="76" width="6" height="10" rx="2" fill="#b07a3f"/>
  <!-- back cushion -->
  <rect x="18" y="20" width="64" height="46" rx="12" fill="#c0392b"/>
  <rect x="24" y="26" width="52" height="34" rx="8" fill="#e0574a"/>
  <!-- back highlight -->
  <rect x="30" y="30" width="14" height="24" rx="6" fill="#f2837a" opacity="0.8"/>
  <!-- armrests -->
  <rect x="10" y="48" width="18" height="30" rx="9" fill="#a93226"/>
  <rect x="72" y="48" width="18" height="30" rx="9" fill="#a93226"/>
  <rect x="13" y="51" width="12" height="22" rx="6" fill="#cf4638"/>
  <rect x="75" y="51" width="12" height="22" rx="6" fill="#cf4638"/>
  <!-- seat cushion -->
  <rect x="22" y="56" width="56" height="22" rx="8" fill="#d94f41"/>
  <rect x="26" y="59" width="48" height="12" rx="5" fill="#ee6f62"/>
  <!-- seat shading -->
  <rect x="26" y="70" width="48" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="#b83d31"/>
  <!-- tiny button detail on back -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="40" r="4" fill="#f7a99e"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="40" r="2" fill="#c0392b"/>
</svg>
